title: Out of the door by eight
checked: Every reachable state checked (7 states, 17 with their data, 18 steps). All 3 rules hold.

rules.rule: Every step can happen, and none is a dead end
rules.says: Each of the 7 states is reached from the start, every step can fire, and no state leaves you stuck.

rules.rule: One in the bathroom at a time
rules.says: Two children are never in the bathroom at once.
The door opens only when all four have their shoes on.
rules.path: Take away the all ready guard and it breaks in 7 steps: snooze, Mia gets up, Leo's turn, Sam's turn, to the table, shoes on, leave.
